name: @storytree/repo-checks
description: Storytree's own repository checks (story_c27bd2a8f61e, question_eda214a321bb, ADR-1199): the checks this repository runs on every pull request to keep itself honest, neither a base part shipped to users nor one of the owner's factory plugins. The leak, secret and push scans, the seed-records check, the lockfile report, the capability-list check, and storytree's declarations for the Guardrails story's package, type-import and allocation checks. CI and the root package.json run them from here, and the gate runs those it can through this package's gateSteps.
